cards.title: The CASA Current
cards.challenge: People in Afghanistan use about 142 kWh of electricity a year, against the Living Line of 1,000 kWh.
cards.advises: Afghanistan should complete its stretch of the CASA transmission line with the development banks and trust funds already behind it, and take a share of the Central Asian power it carries for its own towns and clinics.

cards.title: Snowmelt to Every Tap
cards.challenge: Only 31% of people in Afghanistan use safely managed drinking water.
cards.advises: Afghanistan should invite private water operators and impact investors to build and run small piped networks in towns and villages under contracts that UN agencies and donors can monitor, so the snowmelt of the Hindu Kush reaches every home safely.

cards.title: The Clinic in Every Phone
cards.challenge: Afghanistan scores 42 of 100 on the WHO index of essential health service coverage, and women have been barred from medical training since December 2024.
cards.advises: Afghanistan should welcome telecom and pharmaceutical companies into a telemedicine and medicine partnership, so women in every province can consult women doctors at home and in the diaspora by video, and clinics never run short of essential medicines.

cards.title: The Clean Coast Compact
cards.challenge: Only 69.3% of people in Albania use safely managed sanitation, and 2.7% of city dwellers live in slums.
cards.advises: Albania should finance sewers and treatment plants for its towns and its coast with the European Investment Bank and the EBRD as it prepares to join the European Union, so the clean sea that brings its visitors is protected for the people who live beside it.

cards.title: Water Follows the Visitors
cards.challenge: Only 70.8% of people in Albania use safely managed drinking water.
cards.advises: Albania should invite the hotel groups of its coast to co-invest in the water systems of the towns that host them, under long-term supply contracts, so the safe water their guests need reaches every family in the same streets.

cards.title: The Diaspora Health Bond

cards.title: The Beyond-Oil Venture Fund
